title: Reproducibility, eval resolution update, and plot annotation improvements
body:
Addresses several experiment quality and plot clarity issues: fixed non-deterministic training runs, corrected evaluation resolution range, and added missing contextual annotations to panel plots. Also removes the misleading multi-α/β panel for PINN (which is trained on a single fixed parameter).

## Changes

### `main.py`
- **Seed everything** at the start of `main()` — `random`, `numpy`, `torch` (CPU + CUDA), plus `cudnn.deterministic = True` / `benchmark = False`
- **Eval resolutions**: `[res/2, res, 2×res]` → `[res, 2×res, 3×res]`

### `plots.py`
- `plot_model2_alpha_beta_panel`: accepts `resolution=None`; each stacked-curve subplot title now shows the evaluated resolution; time labels `t=min, 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, max` added to each curve on the left panel
- `plot_model2_resolution_panel`: accepts `param_value=None`; each stacked-curve subplot title now shows `α = β = x.xxx`; same time labels added

### `FNO/plots_fno.py`, `PINO/plots_pino.py`
- Pass `resolution=median_res` and `param_value=median_param` to the respective panel functions

### `PINN/plots_pinn.py`
- **Remove alpha/beta panel** from `eval_pinn_2` — PINN is trained on a single fixed `α = β`, so sweeping other parameter values with the same model produces a misleading plot
- Pass `param_value=median_param` to the resolution panel; clean up now-unused import
